projects.title: TruLoop Product Review Platform
projects.description: A work-in-progress product-review platform exploring more useful feedback than star ratings alone. The current implementation includes product browsing, review submission, authentication, and a heuristic receipt-text check; that check is not proof of purchase.
highlights: Built a responsive Next.js App Router frontend with reusable React components.
Connected Express API routes to MongoDB-backed product, review, and user models.
Added GitHub Actions checks for reproducible installs, backend tests, JavaScript syntax, and a production frontend build.

projects.title: TechFest Registration Platform
projects.description: A web-based registration platform built for a college techfest. I developed the responsive frontend, tested form behavior for different inputs, and supported live event operations with registrations for more than 8,000 students.
highlights: Created an alternative to traditional form-based registration.
Refined the interface and form behavior under live-event time constraints.
Worked with a team that delivered a registration flow for a large student event.

projects.title: Developer Portfolio
projects.description: A recruiter-focused portfolio built to present projects, internship experience, technical skills, and contact details in one responsive place. The site uses a reusable React component structure and plain CSS, with light and dark themes.
highlights: Built a responsive layout with reusable sections for work, experience, skills, education, and contact.
Added a persisted theme toggle, reduced-motion support, and keyboard-friendly navigation.
Set up automated validation and deployment through GitHub Actions.
